title: Sort Receipts for the Bookkeeper
summary: Collect receipts in one place, sort them into expense groups and flag gaps before the bookkeeper sees them.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes you send receipts to a bookkeeper each month; the value is less month-end chasing.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Fewer missing receipts at month end.
Less time spent by the bookkeeper chasing details.
who_its_for: Small businesses that send receipts to a bookkeeper.
Freelancers who track their own expenses.

stack.name: Receipt Scanner / Expense Tracking
stack.role: Reads receipts and sorts them into expense lines.
stack.creator: limeunfiltered

stack.name: Bookkeeping Auditor
stack.role: Checks the expense lines for gaps and odd entries.
stack.creator: mrfundman

steps.name: You
steps.does: Fixes gaps and sends the list

steps: Run the receipt scanner on the folder.
Send the checked list to your bookkeeper.
guardrails: Check every amount against the original receipt.
The bots do not file taxes or move money.
